meta.description: Statistical visualization with pandas integration. Use for quick exploration of distributions, relationships, and categorical comparisons with attractive defaults. Best for box plots, violin plots, pair plots, heatmaps. Built on matplotlib. For interactive plots use plotly; for publication styling use scientific-visualization.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabrication; documentation accurately represents seaborn 0.13.2 API with clear version-specific notes on API changes

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for statistical visualization; clear boundaries to plotly for interactivity and scientific-visualization for publication styling

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established statistical graphics principles and dataset-oriented plotting methodology

code_usability.detail: All code examples are syntactically correct with proper imports; API changes from 0.12/0.13 clearly documented

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of seaborn capabilities including function interface, objects interface, data structure requirements, plotting types, grids, and theming with excellent reference organization

reliability.note: Excellent API change documentation for 0.12/0.13 transitions; patterns and troubleshooting reference provided; minor: lacks explicit error handling patterns for common failures

performance_context.note: Well-organized documentation (255 lines) with clear sections and progressive disclosure through 6 reference files

agent_usability.note: Excellent design philosophy section; clear guidance on function vs objects interface; strong semantic mapping explanations; comprehensive best practices with plot type selection guide

human_usability.note: Clear installation with version pinning (0.13.2); quick start example; data structure requirements well explained; saving figures documented

security.note: Good practice noting sns.load_dataset() downloads public data and recommending local files for private work; minor: could emphasize data anonymization for visualization of sensitive data

maintainability.note: Excellent structure with version 1.2, license (BSD-3-Clause), comprehensive reference files, clear API migration notes, allowed-tools specified

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with pandas and matplotlib; clear when-to-use guidance for function vs objects interface; experimental API warning for objects interface; minor: output format specifications could be more explicit

recommendations.title: Add common error handling patterns
recommendations.problem: No explicit guidance on handling common plotting failures
recommendations.root_cause: Patterns and troubleshooting reference mentioned but not inline examples
recommendations.fix: Add troubleshooting section covering: 'KeyError: column not found', empty plots from incorrect data types, memory issues with large datasets, and categorical encoding errors

recommendations.title: Clarify wide-form decision criteria
recommendations.problem: Use cases for wide-form listed but no clear guidance on when to prefer it
recommendations.root_cause: Documentation emphasizes long-form preference without nuanced trade-offs
recommendations.fix: Add decision note: 'Use wide-form when: (1) plotting matrix data directly as heatmap, (2) x-axis is implicit index/time and each column is a series, (3) source data is already wide and transformation adds no value'

recommendations.title: Add data anonymization note for sensitive visualizations
recommendations.problem: Security section mentions private data but not visualization-specific concerns
recommendations.root_cause: Visualizations can reveal sensitive patterns even when individual values are aggregated
recommendations.fix: Add security note: 'When visualizing sensitive data, consider: aggregation thresholds to prevent identification, removing or generalizing axis labels with PII, and reviewing plots for inadvertent disclosure before sharing'
